QuestInfo.name: [Weekly Quest] World Tree: Top Tier - Eliminate the Shieldbearers
QuestInfo.0: According to Alchetto, the demons are beyond reason. Give them an end worthy of their previous valor and purify the World Tree.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat either the dark demon shieldbearers or the dark demon shieldmasters from the upper tier of the World Tree and purify the World Tree.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the shieldbearers. The World Tree feels a little less dark.
